reconcile.note: Gill treats the two pleas as the same request in different words: the demons preferred roaming the district to being remanded to the abyss, their former prison.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Joseph Fitzmyer notes that Luke's distinctive term abyssos carries apocalyptic weight absent from Mark's plainer phrase, suggesting redaction rather than a single utterance recast two ways.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Joseph A. Fitzmyer (1981), The Gospel According to Luke (I-IX), Anchor Bible 28.
